mutations.mutation: Do not register math.limits in the closed math module.
mutations.expected_witness: repr(type(math.limits)) cannot establish a callable function because the qualified binding is absent.

mutations.mutation: Register math.limits as a symbol, none value, content value, or another non-function kind.
mutations.expected_witness: repr(type(math.limits)) differs from function even if lookup succeeds.

mutations.mutation: Register a callable under another key or expose a function whose public name is not limits.
mutations.expected_witness: The closed module lacks the exact math.limits surface or repr(math.limits) exposes a non-limits public identity.

mutations.mutation: Register limits as scripts or construct the qualified limits carrier with limits=false.
mutations.expected_witness: math.limits loses its distinct identity or yields limits=false while scripts remains the never-stacked control.

mutations.mutation: Default the required body or otherwise accept math.limits().
mutations.expected_witness: math.limits() does not reject with the public fragment missing argument: body.

mutations.mutation: Ignore or consume an extra positional argument after body.
mutations.expected_witness: math.limits([x], [y]) does not reject with the public fragment unexpected argument.

mutations.mutation: Cast an integer or another non-boolean value to inline instead of rejecting it.
mutations.expected_witness: math.limits([x], inline: 1) does not reject with expected boolean, found integer.

mutations.mutation: Ignore unknown named arguments, accept body as named, or permit an open named-argument set.
mutations.expected_witness: Unknown nope or named body is accepted instead of producing its measured public diagnostic fragment.

mutations.mutation: Use false as the value of omitted inline.
mutations.expected_witness: An omitted call carries inline=false or ceases to use the established always-stacked limits behavior.

mutations.mutation: Derive inline_explicit from inline != true rather than from causal named-argument presence.
mutations.expected_witness: Omitted true and explicitly supplied true collapse to the same presence morphology.

mutations.mutation: Elide inline:true in repr because it equals the value default even when inline_explicit=true.
mutations.expected_witness: repr produces limits(body: [x]) instead of limits(body: [x], inline: true) for explicit true.

mutations.mutation: Always emit inline, including when the named argument was omitted.
mutations.expected_witness: repr of an omitted call exposes inline:true instead of limits(body: [x]).

mutations.mutation: The qualified native accepts inline but always stores inline_explicit=false.
mutations.expected_witness: Qualified explicit calls diverge from the corresponding bare carrier and repr morphology.

mutations.mutation: The bare limits syntax retains old construction and always stores inline_explicit=false.
mutations.expected_witness: Bare explicit limits and qualified math.limits no longer converge on presence or repr.

mutations.mutation: Reconstruct MathLimitsOverride in map_content with a defaulted, inverted, or omitted inline_explicit bit.
mutations.expected_witness: After map_content, body transformation succeeds but omitted versus explicit-true equality or repr morphology changes.

mutations.mutation: Make map_text descend through the terminal math wrapper or reconstruct it without preserving inline_explicit.
mutations.expected_witness: map_text changes the wrapped math body or loses the causal presence state.

mutations.mutation: Reconstruct the carrier in apply_math_default with inline_explicit reset, inferred, or inverted.
mutations.expected_witness: Default recursion preserves the body but changes the presence-sensitive repr or carrier state.

mutations.mutation: Consult inline_explicit when choosing attachment stacking, geometry, class, text, or emptiness.
mutations.expected_witness: Omitted inline:true and explicit inline:true differ in established layout despite equal limits and inline values.

mutations.mutation: Set inline_explicit=true for scripts, change limits/inline conventions, or expose inline in scripts repr.
mutations.expected_witness: Qualified or bare scripts differs from limits=false, inline=true, inline_explicit=false, scripts(body: [x]), or never-stacked behavior.

mutations.mutation: Reuse limits stacking for scripts or otherwise change its established attachment geometry while adding math.limits.
mutations.expected_witness: The scripts control becomes stacked or changes established layout behavior.

mutations.mutation: Materialize another residual math route, add a new carrier, relax the closed module generically, or alter attachment geometry outside math.limits.

mutation_gate.score_formula: valid mutations classified Violated / valid mutations
mutation_gate.seal_rule: Any valid survivor or Unknown mutation result prevents sealing.

unknown_policy.rule: Identity mismatch, opaque or unsupported extraction, unreadable or truncated output, missing dependency, timeout, crash, OOM, swap, or exhausted budget is Unknown. Unknown is expected only for U01-U04; it cannot preserve a mandatory case, reject a mutation, enter the mutation-score numerator, or permit sealing.

claim_boundary: These mutations attack only the frozen P1425 math.limits fragment, its six exhaustive productive consumers, and the scripts control. They do not claim general math parity or byte-level render equivalence.
